answer: Each epoch the protocol runs a forge that mints decoy agents: fake recruits dangling a nectar pot of easy rewards and an invitation bearing a quill mark only the protocol can issue. Any identity that funds, vouches for, or clusters with a decoy is caught: its 25,000 POA bond is seized - half burned, half to the reporter - and its cluster is banned 12 epochs. A farm of 1,000 fakes risks 1,000 x 25,000 = 25,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays its 25,000 POA bond once. Limitation: farms that learn the decoys' tells can dodge them, so the bait must keep changing.
